summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. New /api/tools/{id}/detail endpoint and /tool/:id frontend route fully verified. 22/22 backend tests pass (5 new TestToolDetail tests added). All frontend flows for the new ToolDetail page work: navigation from ToolsDirectory and CompatibilityChecker, hero/requirements/commands/steps/troubleshooting render, back link returns to /#tools, 404 page shows for unknown ids. No regression on home page sections.

integration_issues.issue: In headless test env clipboard API is unavailable; the catch block runs and the button does NOT toggle to 'Copied' visual state. In a real browser this works because navigator.clipboard succeeds. Not a real bug, just noting that the visual-state toggle is gated entirely on the clipboard write succeeding. If you want headless-friendly UX, you could optimistically toggle the state and fall back on failure.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: route /tools/{tool_id}/detail is declared after /tools/{tool_id} but FastAPI matches the more specific path correctly because of the literal '/detail' suffix - no ordering issue, verified by tests.

ToolDetail.jsx CommandBlock: copy button visual 'Copied' state is only set inside the try block; in headless the clipboard call rejects so state never toggles. Consider toggling first and reverting on failure for a more resilient UX.

tool_details.py: 'xinaA15' key matches TOOLS id casing; if anyone normalizes ids to lowercase later this lookup will silently fall through to the empty extras dict (returns base tool with no requirements/commands). Currently safe.
Detail endpoint returns plain dict (Dict[str, Any]) - no Pydantic schema means clients have no contract enforcement. For an info hub this is acceptable, but a TypedDict / Pydantic model would help.
